BiblicalUsage: Jetheth is an Edomite, a chief of Edom. In Genesis 36:40, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth. The fuller story is told on the Jetheth profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jetheth belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
